optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Model Evaluation Engineer, Enterprise Knowledge Base
professionalSummary: Experienced in end‑to‑end evaluation of enterprise knowledge base models, managing large question‑answer sets, scoring scripts, and pre‑release evaluation reports.
Collaborated closely with model and content teams to refine evaluation sets and document limitations and hand‑over conditions.
Led the production of detailed evaluation reports that informed ship/hold decisions for multiple model releases.
experienceHighlights: Maintained ~1,900 question‑answer pairs across four content domains and scoring scripts that compute answer correctness and citation accuracy (src_c6379bf0ab40).
Ran pre‑release evaluations for five model versions, publishing per‑domain breakdown reports to the model team and head of product (src_186c8ee4f521).
Coordinated evaluation‑set changes with model and content teams during fortnightly quality reviews, documenting responsibility boundaries (src_4f3c77906265).
Authored evaluation notes for each version, detailing set composition, known limitations (e.g., under‑sampled new content domains), and hand‑over items (src_8cf140792f84).
projectsAndWorkSamples: Scoring script repository README and evaluation report for version 4.1, including evaluation run identifiers as verification trail (src_6e83d35e07ab).
optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The resume and work sample provide evidence of the candidate’s responsibilities in evaluation set maintenance, scoring script development, pre‑release evaluation, coordination with model and content teams, and documentation of limitations. They do not establish that the candidate has the final decision authority over model ship/hold.
